{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm deduplication worked
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f'Expected 800 patients, got {len(df_dedup)}'

# Compute fraction with severe baseline disease
severe_fraction = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)['severe']

# Print result
print(severe_fraction)"}
